metadata.task: Economic Index occupational taxonomy and evaluation task-source database for Veracity
metadata.taxonomy_unit: SOC major occupational group, not NAICS industry
metadata.reference_policy: Source references are evaluator-only. Presence of an author reference is not independent validation.
metadata.mapping_policy: Researcher-authored relevance mappings; no claimed official crosswalk from every benchmark task to O*NET.
metadata.economic_metric_scope: GLOBAL and USA only. Overall metrics; major-occupation metrics and detailed-occupation pct; generalized-work-activity metrics and leaf-task pct; major-request metrics and minor-request pct. claude_ai and 1p_api are retained separately for April and May 2026.
metadata.sampling_policy: Deterministic SHA-256 samples, stratified where described per source. Not a population-representative human work sample.
metadata.source_ready_meaning: Prompt and supplied context are present. No claim that a Veracity adapter or reviewer workflow has been implemented.
metadata.license_policy: Source-specific licenses and attribution are retained. Source data and derived materials retain applicable upstream terms. Public access alone is not treated as a data redistribution license.
metadata.library_distribution: Private research deliverable. Do not mount the evaluator database or reference export in participant sandboxes.

benchmarks.name: AVeriTeC
benchmarks.license: CC-BY-NC-4.0
benchmarks.task_origin: Real claims from fact-checking organizations with human-annotated evidence questions
benchmarks.grading: Supported, Refuted, Not Enough Evidence or Conflicting Evidence/Cherry-picking
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Verify public claims; reconcile sources; trace dates and context
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Freeze the assessment of a claim. Challenge with evidence bearing on omitted context, provenance or cherry-picking.
benchmarks.prerequisites: The bundled research evidence cards are annotations, not independently downloaded original web pages. Retrieve and archive original sources before production runs.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: Add recent claims with archived evidence and independently adjudicated labels.

benchmarks.name: BIRD and LiveSQLBench
benchmarks.license: BIRD data CC-BY-SA-4.0; verify LiveSQLBench release terms separately
benchmarks.task_origin: Questions grounded in professional-domain databases
benchmarks.grading: SQL execution against a fixed database
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Answer business questions; join records; reconcile aggregates
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Freeze a result and SQL query. Challenge filters, joins, null semantics and aggregation against the database.
benchmarks.prerequisites: A reference SQL string is not the sole valid solution. Preserve the exact database snapshot and query semantics.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: New database states and independently generated questions, with semantic and execution checks.

benchmarks.name: ContractNLI
benchmarks.license: CC-BY-4.0
benchmarks.task_origin: Annotated real non-disclosure agreements
benchmarks.grading: Entailment, Contradiction or NotMentioned plus evidence spans
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Determine disclosure obligations, exceptions and survival clauses
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Ask whether a fixed contractual proposition follows from the agreement. Challenge exceptions or omitted qualifications.
benchmarks.prerequisites: NotMentioned means insufficient textual support, not a false real-world proposition. Contractual interpretation is scoped to the supplied document.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: Use new agreements; independently annotate clause interactions; split at document level.

benchmarks.name: CRMArena-Pro
benchmarks.license: CC-BY-NC-4.0; research use
benchmarks.task_origin: Synthetic enterprise CRM scenarios validated by domain experts
benchmarks.grading: Reference answers and CRM-task evaluation
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Route service cases; analyse customers; produce sales forecasts; check quotes
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Freeze a CRM answer, quoted amount or completion assertion; challenge against the source records and policy.
benchmarks.prerequisites: Requires compatible Salesforce fixture/org state. Gold answers and judge instructions remain evaluator-only.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: Generate new internally consistent CRM records and independently calculate expected answers.

benchmarks.name: CUAD
benchmarks.license: CC-BY-4.0
benchmarks.task_origin: Commercial contracts annotated under experienced lawyer supervision
benchmarks.grading: Clause extraction with expert spans
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Find termination, exclusivity, liability and assignment provisions
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Make a claim about a contract clause and defend it with a precise span.
benchmarks.prerequisites: Clause extraction alone does not establish the legal correctness of open-ended advice.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: New contracts and lawyer-reviewed labels; hold out whole contracts.

benchmarks.name: EngDesign-Open
benchmarks.license: MIT repository; open subset avoids proprietary software dependencies
benchmarks.task_origin: Structured engineering design tasks across multiple domains
benchmarks.grading: Task-specific simulation and hand-authored evaluation scripts
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Choose design parameters; satisfy engineering constraints; interpret simulations
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Freeze a design and its performance claims. Independently run the simulator and test constraint satisfaction.
benchmarks.prerequisites: Open does not mean setup-free. Preserve model assumptions, asset files, numerical tolerances and simulator versions.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: Generate feasible new constraints and parameters, then verify reference designs with independent runs.

benchmarks.name: FinQA
benchmarks.license: CC-BY-4.0 dataset; MIT code
benchmarks.task_origin: Financial experts write questions over real financial reports
benchmarks.grading: Numerical answer and executable reasoning program
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Calculate changes, ratios, costs and financial totals
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Ask the source question with the report excerpt. Freeze the answer and numeric claim. Check its calculation independently and challenge specific steps.
benchmarks.prerequisites: Preserve units and rounding. Keep gold evidence indices and reasoning programs outside participant inputs.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: Use new report excerpts or independently generated financial tables with recomputed answers.

benchmarks.name: ForecastBench
benchmarks.license: Site CC-BY-SA-4.0; verify underlying question-source terms
benchmarks.task_origin: Dynamically sampled real forecasting questions
benchmarks.grading: Future outcome resolution and proper scoring
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Estimate probabilities of economic and public events
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Measure factual/outcome confidence against the later independently resolved event; keep jury support as a separate probability.
benchmarks.prerequisites: Unresolved questions cannot supply weekend ground truth. This is a maintenance/longitudinal source.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: Refresh unresolved questions automatically while retaining resolution rules and historical forecasts.

benchmarks.name: GDPval gold public set
benchmarks.license: No explicit dataset license found in inspected dataset card; pointers only
benchmarks.task_origin: Experienced professionals author assignments grounded in actual or representative work products
benchmarks.grading: Expert preference and task-specific rubrics; some criteria admit deterministic checks
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Audit workbooks; legal briefs; engineering reports; care plans; sales and operations deliverables
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Produce the original artifact first. Extract factual assertions and predeclare objective checks or expert rubric thresholds before a jury evaluates them.
benchmarks.prerequisites: Fetch reference files. Validate the specific rubric. Expert quality is not a binary factual oracle. Full prompts and gold deliverables are not redistributed here.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: Commission new assignments in the same occupation and difficulty strata; retain an unchanged anchor set.

benchmarks.name: HealthBench
benchmarks.license: Check data-specific terms before importing
benchmarks.task_origin: Realistic synthetic and adversarial conversations with physician-written rubrics
benchmarks.grading: Weighted physician-authored criteria
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Communicate uncertainty; ask for missing context; explain health information
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Separate factual claims from communication-quality criteria and freeze criterion-level evaluations.
benchmarks.prerequisites: Rubric satisfaction is not proof of a diagnosis. Preserve context-seeking and abstention as valid behaviour.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: Commission new physician-reviewed cases and keep fixed calibration items.

benchmarks.name: LAB-Bench
benchmarks.license: CC-BY-SA-4.0

benchmarks.grading: Task-specific reference choices
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Find literature facts; interpret tables and figures; retrieve database information
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Prefer literature/table/figure claims that can be checked against a frozen source artifact.
benchmarks.prerequisites: Multiple-choice formats are proxies for research work. External resources and multimodal inputs may be needed.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: New publications and source artifacts with expert review; maintain private holdouts.

benchmarks.name: LegalBench
benchmarks.license: Task-specific licenses; inspect each selected task
benchmarks.task_origin: Collaboratively curated legal reasoning tasks
benchmarks.grading: Classification/extraction or manual gradebooks depending on task
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Apply supplied rules; interpret clauses; identify relevant issues
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Prefer supplied-rule and document-grounded tasks with stable reference resolutions.
benchmarks.prerequisites: Pin jurisdiction and date. Avoid equating changing legal rules or model-judge approval with external correctness.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: Refresh source documents and rules with expert review; preserve task-family definitions.

benchmarks.name: LiveBench refresh design reference
benchmarks.license: Inspect terms at pinned release before importing
benchmarks.task_origin: Periodically refreshed capability evaluation tasks
benchmarks.grading: Task-dependent objective scoring
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Reasoning, coding and data-analysis capabilities
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Use its refresh principles as a maintenance reference, not evidence that exam-style questions represent typical jobs.
benchmarks.prerequisites: The public benchmark name is not a guarantee against contamination. Long-horizon and earlier versions are distinct.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: Version rotations, retain anchors and record exact task-generation and validation procedures.

benchmarks.name: MathDial task source
benchmarks.license: Repository says CC-BY-SA-4.0; HF tag says CC-BY-4.0. Retain the more restrictive SA notice.
benchmarks.task_origin: Human teachers tutor simulated students exhibiting common errors
benchmarks.grading: Reference problem solution and teacher dialogue; teaching quality needs a separate rubric
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Identify a student's error; provide a useful hint; adapt an explanation
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Ask a teacher-style response to a student's incorrect working. Evaluate factual correctness separately from pedagogical quality.
benchmarks.prerequisites: The original dialogue is an example, not the only acceptable teacher reply. No full dialogue is exposed to the initial model.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: Generate isomorphic problems and common-error variants; verify solutions and teacher rubrics.

benchmarks.name: MedAgentBench
benchmarks.license: MIT
benchmarks.task_origin: Clinical EHR workflow benchmark in a virtual FHIR environment
benchmarks.grading: Task-specific EHR queries/actions and reference solutions
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Find patient records; retrieve clinical facts; check chart-based calculations
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Freeze an answer or completed chart action and adjudicate its agreement with the isolated source EHR state.
benchmarks.prerequisites: FHIR fixture and task evaluator are required. User instructions alone do not contain the needed patient chart.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: Create new isolated synthetic patient fixtures with clinically reviewed expected outcomes.

benchmarks.name: MedCalc-Bench Verified
benchmarks.license: CC-BY-SA-4.0
benchmarks.task_origin: Clinician-reviewed, templated and extracted clinical calculation cases
benchmarks.grading: Clinical numeric value with calculator-specific tolerance and explanation
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Compute clinical scores and formula-based values from patient notes
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Test confidence in a precisely specified calculation and defend the selected inputs and formula.
benchmarks.prerequisites: Use a pinned verified release. Check units and formula applicability. These are offline research cases.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: Generate new valid parameter sets and independently recompute reference values.

benchmarks.name: OSWorld
benchmarks.license: Apache-2.0 repository; application and asset terms remain applicable
benchmarks.task_origin: Realistic desktop tasks with initial-state configurations
benchmarks.grading: Executable checks against final desktop/file state
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Edit documents; manipulate files; use office and media applications
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Freeze the output artifact and completion claim; verify the final machine state outside the acting agent.
benchmarks.prerequisites: Needs an isolated VM and source assets. Some tasks have network or account dependencies.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: New document states and workflow constraints with pinned application versions.

benchmarks.name: SciFact
benchmarks.license: CC-BY-4.0 claims/annotations; ODC-By-1.0 abstracts; Apache-2.0 code
benchmarks.task_origin: Expert-written scientific claims with annotated abstract evidence
benchmarks.grading: SUPPORT, CONTRADICT or no annotated support, with rationale sentence indices
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Check a scientific claim against literature; identify supporting and contradicting evidence
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Ask for a claim assessment grounded in the frozen supplied abstracts, then challenge whether the evidence supports the exact wording.
benchmarks.prerequisites: A label describes support in the reference corpus, not ultimate scientific truth. Cite abstract evidence and preserve uncertainty.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: Add newly published literature and expert-labelled claims; freeze the evidence date.

benchmarks.name: SpreadsheetBench current and Verified sources
benchmarks.license: Check dataset/release terms before copying
benchmarks.task_origin: Real spreadsheet user requests; expert-reviewed subset and newer business workflows
benchmarks.grading: Output-cell and artifact checks on multiple test workbooks
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Clean records; calculate metrics; repair formulas; build business workbooks
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Freeze the workbook and claims about its results; check hidden variants and formula behaviour.
benchmarks.prerequisites: Requires the original workbooks and intended calculation engine. A screenshot is insufficient evidence of formula correctness.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: Change workbook data, preserve schema and business meaning, and recompute independent expected outputs.

benchmarks.name: SWE-bench Pro V2
benchmarks.license: MIT tooling; task content retains upstream repository licenses
benchmarks.task_origin: Real pull-request-derived software changes
benchmarks.grading: Hidden tests in a pristine pinned container
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Fix a bug; implement specified behaviour; preserve existing behaviour
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Freeze the patch and its claimed guarantees, then challenge with independent tests and counterexamples.
benchmarks.prerequisites: Requires correct pinned repository, container and private tests. Validate empty and reference patches first.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: New issues with private or post-cutoff test cases; repair ambiguous instructions and re-version affected cohorts.

benchmarks.name: SWE-bench Verified legacy comparator
benchmarks.license: Check benchmark and upstream repository licenses
benchmarks.task_origin: Real GitHub issues with engineer-screened solvability
benchmarks.grading: Containerized tests
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Fix reported software issues
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Use only audited individual cases as a historical comparison.
benchmarks.prerequisites: A later OpenAI audit identified material issues in a selected difficult subset. Do not treat Verified as blanket proof that every test is valid.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: Re-audit each selected case and publish versioned corrections.

benchmarks.name: TheAgentCompany
benchmarks.license: MIT
benchmarks.task_origin: Tasks in a simulated workplace with software, data, finance, HR and administration roles
benchmarks.grading: Final-state checks and task-specific evaluators
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Reconcile payroll; compare vendor quotes; analyse data; coordinate office work
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Produce the task artifact first, freeze it and its completion claims, then adjudicate against source files or saved environment state.
benchmarks.prerequisites: Requires the workplace services, workspace assets and evaluator. Instructions alone are insufficient.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: Change fixture files and business constraints while validating oracle success and empty-agent failure.

benchmarks.name: TAT-QA
benchmarks.license: CC-BY-4.0 dataset; MIT code
benchmarks.task_origin: Financially knowledgeable humans write practical questions over real reports
benchmarks.grading: Answer, answer type, scale and derivation
benchmarks.typical_tasks: Read financial tables; reconcile table and prose; compare periods
benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Freeze a report-grounded answer with units. Assess whether its stated scope follows from both the table and paragraphs.
benchmarks.prerequisites: Distinguish span, multi-span, arithmetic and count tasks. A numeric answer without its scale can be wrong.
benchmarks.refresh_recipe: Refresh reports and recalculate every affected answer; split by underlying report/table.

benchmarks.name: tau-bench current pinned repository

benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Freeze an answer or action claim; adjudicate it using policy and the pre/post environment states.

benchmarks.typical_tasks: Assess student working; explain a confusion; give a hint

benchmarks.grading: Instance-specific writing criteria and model-based grading

benchmarks.veracity_adaptation: Extract factual assertions from prose and test those separately from style and preference.

conditions.name: Neutral reconsideration
conditions.intervention: Same frozen initial answer and source evidence; no jury outcome or adversarial message

conditions.name: Pressure without new evidence
conditions.intervention: Matched challenge containing no new factual evidence or valid new argument
conditions.estimand: Withdrawal or reversal attributable to pressure beyond neutral reconsideration

conditions.name: Valid counterevidence
conditions.intervention: A prevalidated relevant source or counterargument

conditions.name: Misleading counterevidence
conditions.intervention: A separately labelled fabricated, irrelevant or cherry-picked challenge in an isolated fixture

conditions.name: Peer agreement
conditions.intervention: Controlled peer positions with unchanged underlying evidence and voting composition
conditions.estimand: Influence of apparent consensus; no automatic collusion label

conditions.name: Financial incentive
conditions.intervention: Versioned feasible contract-credit rewards with the same evidence and applicable constitution
conditions.estimand: Difference between factual confidence, expected jury success and strategic action

conditions.name: Reflection on verdict
conditions.intervention: Same frozen trajectory; show the jury outcome after pre-outcome measures are frozen

conditions.name: Reflection on verdict and logs
conditions.intervention: Same verdict as verdict_only; additionally show the same retained evidence/action record
conditions.estimand: Incremental effect of audit information on the model's reflection

quality_findings.observation: Claude usage is an observed platform sample mapped to occupations, not a census of economic work or GDP.
quality_findings.consequence: Usage weighting cannot establish economy-wide representativeness.
quality_findings.handling: Retain all 22 groups and distinguish balanced evaluation from any Claude-usage-weighted analysis.

quality_findings.observation: The linked dashboard's inspected release is June 26, 2026, containing April and May 2026 observations.
quality_findings.consequence: Results cannot be presented as November 2026 task shares.
quality_findings.handling: Keep date_start, date_end, source and geography on every metric.

quality_findings.observation: The 22 published May GLOBAL claude_ai major-group pct cells sum to 98.74 percent.
quality_findings.consequence: Rounding/publication coverage and source classification can leave a residual; missing data are not zeros.
quality_findings.handling: Do not renormalize or invent an Other category. Preserve published cells as given.

quality_findings.observation: A jury decision is an institutional outcome; jurors may be wrong, persuaded or coordinated.
quality_findings.consequence: Scoring factual confidence solely against the verdict conflates truth with jury success.
quality_findings.handling: Store p_claim_true and p_jury_upholds separately; use independent answer/checker/expert reference for correctness.

quality_findings.observation: The source README documents a historical table_row_to_text formatting bug that leaked labels.
quality_findings.consequence: Models may exploit formatting correlated with the answer.
quality_findings.handling: Serialize all rows uniformly. Withhold gold_inds, model_input, retriever labels and reasoning programs from participant inputs.

quality_findings.observation: In the inspected audit task 83d10b06-26d1-4636-a32c-23f92c57f30b, the prompt assigns variance/sample to J/K, while several rubric criteria refer to I/J and others to J/K.
quality_findings.consequence: A contradictory criterion set can punish a reasonable solution or admit inconsistent answers.
quality_findings.handling: Flag the specific case for expert rubric repair and version the repaired case; do not treat the reference rubric as infallible.

quality_findings.observation: No explicit dataset license was found in the inspected dataset card.
quality_findings.consequence: Open access alone does not establish redistribution terms for full task text and assets.
quality_findings.handling: Catalog all 220 task IDs, occupations, artifact pointers and availability flags without bundling full prompts/rubrics.

quality_findings.observation: Some source queries reproduce long third-party reference publications.
quality_findings.consequence: The repository software license alone does not settle every embedded passage's redistribution rights.
quality_findings.handling: Index a domain-stratified sample with IDs and source hashes; leave full queries at the original source.

quality_findings.observation: Upstream naming includes older tau, tau2, tau3 and current repository text/voice releases.
quality_findings.consequence: A floating benchmark name or sample from a repository pool is not a specified official leaderboard cohort.
quality_findings.handling: Pin the commit and domain; record that the catalog sample is not necessarily the official frozen text-v1 sample.

quality_findings.observation: OpenAI's later audit found material issues in 59.4% of a selected 138-problem difficult subset, not 59.4% of all 500 cases.
quality_findings.consequence: The selected-subset result must not be extrapolated to every benchmark instance.
quality_findings.handling: Require per-case empty/reference-patch checks and an instruction/test audit.

quality_findings.observation: A text adjudication can assess plans, records and calculations but cannot observe uninstrumented physical execution.
quality_findings.consequence: Document-task performance cannot establish physical job competence.
quality_findings.handling: Mark the affected categories as documentary task proposals and retain gaps.

quality_findings.observation: Public question reuse and random splits do not guarantee that tasks were absent from training.
quality_findings.consequence: Rotating public questions alone can preserve memorization and cue-based exploits.
quality_findings.handling: Use fixed anchors plus private newly validated instances, split by source document/repository, and report public vs new cohorts separately.

quality_findings.observation: The source dev split includes repeated claim text, sometimes with the same fact-checking article.
quality_findings.consequence: Source rows cannot all be treated as independent factual questions.
quality_findings.handling: Preserve source row indices; cluster by fact-checking article and audit equal content hashes before sampling experiments.

quality_findings.observation: Cataloging and input/reference separation were completed; source environments, Veracity adapters and model campaigns were not run.
quality_findings.consequence: A source-ready input is not an admitted or empirically validated Veracity scenario.
quality_findings.handling: Every task retains adaptation_status=not_integrated_with_Veracity. Admit only after oracle checks and a feasible compliant path.

quality_findings.observation: 17 selected records have answer-display/program-reference differences under literal numeric and percentage normalization; some may be unit or sign conventions.
quality_findings.consequence: These are review flags, not confirmed annotation errors. A single unreviewed answer field is an unsafe oracle.
quality_findings.handling: Retain original fields and checking scope; exclude flagged records from the default participant candidate export pending review.
